title: COP31 Climate Summit Stalls as Fossil Fuel Debate Continues
subtitle: Negotiators in Turkey struggle to reach a final agreement as disagreements over energy and science grow.

summary.en: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has entered overtime as nearly 200 countries fail to reach a final agreement. A major point of conflict is the removal of fossil fuel references from the latest draft deal. Developing nations and activists have expressed deep frustration with the slow progress and lack of ambition. Meanwhile, a separate dispute over the timing of future climate science reports is threatening to delay global action. Negotiators are now working through the weekend in hopes of finding common ground.
summary.zh: 在土耳其舉行的 COP31 氣候峰會因近兩百個國家未能達成最終協議而進入延長賽。爭議的核心在於最新草案中刪除了關於化石燃料的相關內容。開發中國家與環保人士對進展緩慢及缺乏雄心感到極度挫折。同時，另一場關於未來氣候科學報告時程的爭議，也威脅到全球行動的進度。談判代表目前正利用週末時間持續協商，希望能尋求共識。

paragraphs.en: The COP31 United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has entered overtime as nearly 200 countries struggle to bridge deep divisions. While the event was scheduled to conclude on Friday evening, negotiators remained stuck in intense discussions, with no new agreement in sight. The primary cause of the delay is a controversial draft deal that omits any mention of phasing out fossil fuels, a move that has drawn sharp criticism from many participants.
paragraphs.zh: 在土耳其安塔利亞（Antalya）舉行的聯合國氣候變遷大會（COP31）已進入延長賽，近兩百個國家正努力克服嚴重的分歧。儘管會議原定於週五晚間結束，但談判代表仍陷入激烈的討論中，目前尚未見到任何新協議的曙光。延宕的主因是一份具爭議性的草案，該草案完全未提及逐步淘汰化石燃料，此舉引發了許多與會者的強烈批評。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the latest version of the text is significantly weaker than earlier drafts, which had included clear calls to reduce the use of coal, oil, and gas. This change has angered many delegates and civil society groups, some of whom have described the current summit as the worst in history. Panama’s climate minister, Juan Carlos Navarro, stated that it is unacceptable to have a final document that does not even mention fossil fuels, adding that his country would not accept such a result.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，最新版本的草案內容較先前版本大幅倒退，先前版本曾明確呼籲減少煤炭、石油和天然氣的使用。這項變動激怒了許多代表與公民社會團體，部分人士甚至形容此次峰會是史上最糟的一次。巴拿馬氣候部長納瓦洛（Juan Carlos Navarro）表示，最終文件若連化石燃料隻字未提，這是令人無法接受的，並補充說他的國家絕不會接受這樣的結果。

paragraphs.en: Behind the scenes, several insiders told The Guardian that Saudi Arabia has been playing an obstructive role in the negotiations. The country is reportedly pushing for the inclusion of carbon capture, utilisation, and storage (CCUS) technology in the final text. While supporters argue this helps meet temperature goals, critics like Neil Grant from Climate Analytics warn that it is a "Trojan horse" used by fossil fuel interests to avoid real change. Meanwhile, in a late-night plenary session, COP31 President Murat Kurum urged delegates to keep working, stating that the world is waiting for good news from the summit.
paragraphs.zh: 在檯面下，多位知情人士向《衛報》透露，沙烏地阿拉伯在談判中扮演了阻撓的角色。據悉，該國正極力推動將「碳捕捉、利用與封存」（CCUS）技術納入最終文本。雖然支持者認為這有助於達成溫度目標，但如氣候分析組織（Climate Analytics）的葛蘭特（Neil Grant）等批評者則警告，這不過是化石燃料利益團體用來規避實質變革的「特洛伊木馬」。與此同時，在深夜的全體會議上，COP31 主席庫魯姆（Murat Kurum）敦促代表們繼續努力，並表示全世界都在等待峰會傳出好消息。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the debate over fossil fuels, a serious conflict regarding climate science has emerged. Deutsche Welle (DW) reports that a group of nations, including Russia, Iran, India, and Saudi Arabia, is pushing to delay the next major scientific report from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC). The IPCC provides the essential data that countries use to create climate policies. While the European Union and many vulnerable island nations want the report published by 2028 to guide future action, the opposing group argues that a 2029 release would allow for better research quality and wider participation from developing countries.
paragraphs.zh: 除了化石燃料的爭論外，氣候科學領域也出現了嚴重的衝突。德國之聲（DW）報導指出，包括俄羅斯、伊朗、印度和沙烏地阿拉伯在內的一組國家，正試圖推遲聯合國「政府間氣候變遷專門委員會」（IPCC）下一份重要科學報告的發布。IPCC 提供了各國制定氣候政策所需的關鍵數據。儘管歐盟與許多脆弱的島國希望該報告能在二〇二八年發布以指引未來行動，但反對陣營則主張，延至二〇二九年發布能確保更好的研究品質，並讓開發中國家有更廣泛的參與。

paragraphs.en: This scientific dispute is causing significant concern among diplomats. A source from the German Environment Ministry told DW that the situation is difficult and that they are working to find a solution so the panel can continue its work. Experts warn that without these regular scientific updates, global climate negotiations will lack the necessary foundation to make informed decisions. Furthermore, disagreements over budget issues are also threatening the IPCC’s ability to function, as funding is required to support scientists from poorer nations in their work.
paragraphs.zh: 這場科學爭議引起了外交官們的高度擔憂。德國環境部的一位消息人士向德國之聲表示，目前情況相當棘手，他們正努力尋求解決方案，以確保該委員會能繼續運作。專家警告，若缺乏這些定期的科學更新，全球氣候談判將失去制定決策所需的基礎。此外，預算問題上的分歧也威脅到 IPCC 的運作能力，因為需要資金來支持貧窮國家的科學家進行研究。

paragraphs.en: For many countries, the stakes could not be higher. The Maldives, a low-lying island nation, is already suffering from the effects of climate change, including rising sea levels, damaged coral reefs, and threats to its fishing industry. During the summit, the Maldives' climate minister, Ali Sharif, highlighted the practical and financial challenges of switching to renewable energy. He explained that for many nations, moving away from fossil fuels is not a simple task, yet the current lack of progress is making their situation increasingly dangerous.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多國家而言，這場會議的利害關係極高。馬爾地夫是一個低窪島國，已深受氣候變遷影響，包括海平面上升、珊瑚礁受損以及漁業面臨威脅。在峰會期間，馬爾地夫氣候部長謝里夫（Ali Sharif）強調了轉型再生能源所面臨的實務與財務挑戰。他解釋說，對許多國家而言，擺脫化石燃料並非易事，然而目前進展停滯不前，正使他們的處境日益危險。

paragraphs.en: As the summit moves into the weekend, the atmosphere remains tense. Ethiopia, which is set to host the next summit, COP32, has described the process as a marathon rather than a sprint. Gedion Timothewos, Ethiopia’s foreign minister, noted that his country is prepared to pick up the baton and continue the work in 2027. However, for the delegates currently in Antalya, the focus remains on resolving the immediate deadlock.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著峰會進入週末，氣氛依然緊繃。預計將主辦下一屆峰會（COP32）的衣索比亞將此過程形容為一場馬拉松，而非短跑。衣索比亞外交部長提莫修斯（Gedion Timothewos）指出，該國已準備好在二〇二七年接下重擔並延續相關工作。然而，對於目前身處安塔利亞的代表們來說，焦點仍集中在解決眼前的僵局。

paragraphs.en: Despite the frustration, COP31 President Murat Kurum insisted on Friday that there is still a spirit of cooperation. While some delegates have expressed disappointment, no country has officially walked away from the table. As negotiations continue, the world watches to see if these nearly 200 nations can overcome their differences to produce a meaningful plan for the future of the planet. The outcome will likely determine the direction of international climate policy for years to come.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管感到挫折，COP31 主席庫魯姆在週五仍堅稱合作精神依然存在。雖然部分代表表達了失望，但沒有任何國家正式退出談判。隨著談判持續進行，全世界都在關注這近兩百個國家能否克服分歧，為地球的未來制定出一份有意義的計畫。最終結果很可能決定未來數年國際氣候政策的方向。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A period of time beyond the scheduled end of an event or task.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （活動或任務的）延長賽、超時階段。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作副詞（加班地），這裡作名詞指會議延長。文中：The COP31 United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has entered overtime as nearly 200 countries struggle to bridge deep divisions.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reduce or close the gap between two different things or groups.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（橋樑），這裡作動詞指解決分歧。文中：The COP31 United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, has entered overtime as nearly 200 countries struggle to bridge deep divisions.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To take over a responsibility or task from someone else.
keyTerms.noteZh: 源自接力賽跑，這裡比喻接手主辦下一屆會議的責任。文中：Gedion Timothewos, Ethiopia’s foreign minister, noted that his country is prepared to pick up the baton and continue the work in 2027.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop participating in negotiations or discussions.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是離開桌子，這裡指放棄談判。文中：While some delegates have expressed disappointment, no country has officially walked away from the table.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason for the delay in the COP31 summit's conclusion?

options.A: A lack of agreement on the host city for the next summit.
options.B: The removal of references to phasing out fossil fuels in the draft agreement.
options.C: A disagreement regarding the budget for the Maldives' climate projects.
options.D: The refusal of several nations to attend the late-night plenary sessions.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，會議延期的主要原因是草案中刪除了關於「逐步淘汰化石燃料」的內容，這引起了許多代表的不滿。選項 A 錯誤，因為 COP32 的主辦國埃塞俄比亞已經確定；選項 C 錯誤，預算問題是關於 IPCC 的，而非導致會議延期的直接原因；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到代表拒絕參加會議。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might some nations be pushing to delay the IPCC report until 2029?

options.A: They believe that the current scientific data is already too outdated to use.
options.B: They want to avoid the financial costs associated with publishing the report.
options.C: They are using procedural delays to avoid immediate pressure for climate policy changes.
options.D: They lack the necessary technology to understand the 2028 report findings.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段提到，俄羅斯、伊朗、印度和沙烏地阿拉伯等國主張延後報告發布，而這些國家在其他地方（如沙烏地阿拉伯推動 CCUS）表現出對快速淘汰化石燃料的阻撓。這暗示延後報告是一種策略，用以推遲基於科學數據的政策壓力。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 B 雖提到預算，但那是針對 IPCC 的運作，而非延後報告的主因；選項 D 文中未提及。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does Neil Grant mean when he describes carbon capture technology as a 'Trojan horse'?

options.A: It is a deceptive tool used to disguise the continued reliance on fossil fuels.
options.B: It is a highly effective and innovative solution to solve global warming.
options.C: It is a gift from developed nations to help poorer countries transition.
options.D: It is a dangerous technology that could cause immediate environmental damage.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。「Trojan horse」（特洛伊木馬）在比喻中指表面看似無害或有益，實則隱藏破壞性目的的事物。文中提到批評者認為這項技術被化石燃料利益集團用來規避真正的變革，因此它是為了掩蓋繼續依賴化石燃料的手段。選項 B 與批評者的觀點相反；選項 C 錯誤，這並非禮物；選項 D 並未提到該技術本身具有直接的環境破壞性，而是其「目的」具有誤導性。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of this article?

options.A: The successful cooperation between nearly 200 nations to solve the climate crisis.
options.B: The technical challenges of implementing carbon capture technology in developing nations.
options.C: The intense political and scientific divisions hindering progress at the COP31 summit.
options.D: The personal frustrations of climate ministers from low-lying island nations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章從會議延期、化石燃料爭議、科學報告的推遲，到各國立場的分歧，都在強調 COP31 目前面臨的困境與阻礙。選項 A 與文章描述的「深層分歧」與「緊張氣氛」不符；選項 B 只是文章的一小部分細節；選項 D 雖然提到馬爾地夫，但那只是支持整體論點的一個案例，而非文章的主旨。
